title: Protocol to study starvation-induced autophagy in developing rat neurons
protocol: Mix 1 μg of plasmid DNA, encoding either a nanobody or a function-blocking expression protein, with 100 μL of MEM.
Mix 2.5 μL of Lipofectamine 2000 reagent with 100 μL of MEM.
Mix the 100 μL of DNA/MEM and 100 μL of Lipofectamine 2000/MEM and leave at 18°C–25°C for 20 min.
Add the 200 μL solution to a ø35 mm petri dish with coverslips containing 2 days in vitro (DIV) hippocampal neurons.
Leave for 90 min in the CO2 incubator.
Change culture media with starvation media.
Pre-equilibrate the starvation media in the CO2 incubator for a couple of hours.
Remove the N2 media using a vacuum pump and replace it with the starvation media.
Incubate in the CO2 incubator for 24–48 h.
Remove and discard the starvation media from neuronal cultures.
Add pre-warmed (37°C) paraformaldehyde 4% in PBS to completely cover the coverslips.
Leave for 20 min at 18°C–25°C.
Remove the paraformaldehyde solution and replace with PBS.
Wash twice, 4 min each, with PBS.
Quench 20 min at 18°C–25°C with 50 mM NH4Cl in PBS.
Wash twice, 4 min each, with PBS.
Permeabilize 6 min with 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS.
Wash twice, 4 min each, with PBS.
Transfer coverslips onto a parafilm sheet in a humid chamber (cells upward).
Block for 30–60 min at 18°C–25°C with 1% BSA in PBS-0.01% Tween-20 (PBST).
Incubate with the primary antibody for 90 min at 18°C–25°C diluted in 1% BSA/PBST.
Incubate primary antibodies for 10–18 hours at 4°C.
Wash three times, 4 minutes each, with PBS.
Incubate with the secondary antibody for 60 minutes at 18°C–25°C diluted in 1% BSA/PBS.
Wash three times, 4 minutes each, with PBS.
Rinse once in ddH2O.
Lay out a drop of ProlongGold (5–9 μL) in a microscopic slide.
Place the coverslips on top of the ProlongGold, neurons facing down.
Let ProlongGold dry overnight.
Lysate neurons with 500 μL of lysis buffer containing Tris 50 mM, NaCl 150 mM, Triton X-100 1%, EDTA 3 mM, and protease inhibitor cocktail.
Centrifuge the samples at 12,000 g at 4°C for 20 minutes.
Recover the supernatant from the centrifuged samples.
Dilute Bio-Rad Bradford reagent with ddH2O in a ratio of 5:1 and dispense 1 mL into spectrophotometer cuvettes as needed for sample measurement and reference curve.
Prepare a BSA concentration curve using concentrations of 0, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, and 20 μg/μL.
Dilute 2 μL of the recovered supernatant in one cuvette for analysis.
Measure the optical density at 595 nm.
Create a regression curve using reference values to determine the protein concentration of the sample.
Add Laemmli loading buffer to the samples and boil them at 95°C for 5 minutes.
Load 20-30 μg of total protein extract into a 12% SDS-PAGE gel.
Run the gel at 80 V for 30 minutes, then increase to 110 V for approximately 90 minutes until the front reaches the bottom edge of the gel.
Transfer proteins from the gel to a nitrocellulose membrane using chilled transfer buffer and a current of 400 mA for 2-3 hours.
Block membranes with a solution of 2.5% non-fat dry milk in TBST for 30–60 min at 18°C–25°C.
Incubate primary antibodies at 4°C for 10–18 h in TBST supplemented with 2.5% non-fat dry milk solution.
Incubate membranes with secondary antibodies and develop the signal by ECL or fluorescence detection depending on the choice of secondary antibodies.
Run two gels to incubate anti ULK1 and pULK1 antibodies in different membranes due to them being raised in the same species.
